_comment: tools/release/push_repo.tscn: `message` is the commit message (it falls back to a release-tidy message if blank), `check_tag` is a release tag it checks is still live after pushing ("" skips the check).
message:
Every release must ship the real zombies (D-113)

ModelCheck stops a release when a Mixamo model or clip is missing - checked in the editor
before exporting and inside the packaged exe after. Warrok stays the Bloater, Ch10 joins the
shamblers, and the Mixamo textures are VRAM-compressed (48-zombie crowd: 585 -> 272 MB VRAM).
